title: plant
description: A kingdom of organism: a photosynthetic, cell-walled, (mostly) sessile living agent whose body is generated by a persistent meristem rather than assembled. An organism refined by autotrophy, the cell wall, and indeterminate meristematic growth.

autotrophic.description: fixes its own carbon by photosynthesis

cell-walled.description: cells bounded by a (cellulose) wall, giving sessile structural form

meristematic.description: form generated by persistent meristems — indeterminate, open-ended growth
